As of 2025, the population and growth estimates for Cairo, Kinshasa, and Lagos are as follows:

| City | Estimated Population | Estimated Annual Growth Rate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Cairo | ~23.1 million | ~1.07% |
| Kinshasa | ~17.8 million | ~4.38% |
| Lagos | ~17.2 million | ~3.75% |

Kinshasa is the fastest-growing city among the three, maintaining the most aggressive rate of urban expansion. While Cairo currently holds the largest total population, its growth rate is significantly lower than that of both Kinshasa and Lagos. Please note that population figures and growth rates can vary depending on the specific demographic model and the definition of the metropolitan area used by different sources.

Sources: Statista, Macrotrends, World Population Review, Wikipedia, and City Population.
